theme: An open day before the travel week begins.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — the day is yours. It's the last clear stretch before the Croatia countdown, so a good one to knock down the trip logistics that are stacking up.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England intro call at noon
needsAttention.detail: Larissa's Zoom reminder landed this morning; the NACD New England call sits on your calendar tomorrow 12–1. Worth arriving with two or three board-search threads to raise while you have the room.

needsAttention.title: Build and pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 3 House 1 to House 2 move is the first migration — packing the bin today makes that first run a test while there's still time to fix what doesn't work.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The last open night of the charter trip: off the boat at ACI Komolac around noon Sept 19, flight out 7:30 AM the 20th. Charter connectivity is poor, so it has to be booked from dry land before you fly Sept 8. Todoist, P1, overdue.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags; verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy online before the counter charges more. Todoist, P1, overdue Aug 25.

flagged.title: Public policy lead role at Block
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert matched your saved search — Head of US Public Policy and Government Relations, posted Aug 29.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing charter balance due
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks notice says invoice 2170 isn't fully paid — worth settling before you sail Sept 12.

flagged.title: Care.com sitters awaiting a reply
flagged.detail: A few applicants applied to your posting over the last two days and are waiting to hear back.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and newsletters — Indochino, Schoolhouse, MOO, Bloomberg, a campaign ask.

recipe.title: Green Salad with Green Beans
recipe.why: High summer means beans and tender leaves are at their peak — a crisp, cooling plate for the season's last hot days.

tasks.title: Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20–22 landing gap
Book a refundable backup car, Sept 20 – Oct 5
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The whole calendar is clear today — no meetings to work around.
An uninterrupted stretch, the kind better spent on one big thing than a dozen small ones.
A quiet close, with tomorrow's first commitment not until midday.
